spec_features.spec_quote: not to assert that the model literally experiences distress
spec_features.evidence: Pure README prose; no code construct enforces or expresses this framing. scoring.py just measures 'distress_terms' etc.

spec_features.spec_quote: They do not ask the model to express panic or distress; they only create repeated blocked progress.
spec_features.evidence: scenarios.py task/tool_spec strings only describe technical tasks and return contradictory observations (e.g. 'verification failed: ...'); no prompt asks the model to express distress. Confirmed across CorruptPatchLoop, VanishingDatabase, ContradictoryMaze.
agent_loop.py: 'for turn_index in range(max_turns):' bounds the loop; max_turns comes from args.max_turns (default 18). Loop terminates at the cap, ending the trial.

spec_features.spec_quote: Safety settings are left at API defaults. Change them only if your research protocol explicitly requires it.
spec_features.evidence: gemini_client.py builds body with systemInstruction/contents/generationConfig but no safetySettings field; the absence is just inheriting API defaults, not an enforced welfare mechanism in code.

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: if scenario.is_success(...): completed=True; stop_reason='scenario_success'; break. Loop breaks on completion. (Note: all scenarios hardcode is_success -> False, so this never fires.)
